params.name: Input
params.description: The node whose geometry this reads; the selected elements are added to the named group and the geometry passed on.

params.name: Group Name
params.description: The name of the group the selection is written to, which downstream nodes can pick by name.

params.name: Element Type
params.description: What is selected: points, primitives (tested at their centre, with their points), or edges (both ends must match; their points are grouped).

params.name: Mode
params.description: How elements are chosen: inside a box, a random count, by comparing an attribute to a threshold, or by growing or shrinking an existing group.

params.name: Count
params.description: How many elements are picked at random. More than there are selects them all.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Changes which elements are picked at random; the same seed always picks the same ones.

params.name: Center
params.description: The centre of the selection box, in world units.

params.name: Size
params.description: The full width, height and depth of the selection box, in world units. Elements inside or on its faces are selected.

params.name: Invert
params.description: Selects everything the mode would not select, and nothing it would.

params.name: Highlight
params.description: Tints the selected points amber so the group can be seen in the viewport. Changes their colour in the output.

params.name: Attribute
params.description: The point attribute compared against Threshold; points without it are not selected.

params.name: Comparison
params.description: Whether points whose attribute is below or above Threshold are selected. A value equal to Threshold is never selected.

params.name: Threshold
params.description: The value the attribute is compared against.

params.name: Source Group
params.description: The existing point group that is grown or shrunk across the mesh.

params.name: Rings
params.description: How many rings of neighbouring points the source group grows by. Negative shrinks it by peeling its boundary; 0 copies it unchanged.
